task: Write a Python function using boto3 that takes an S3 bucket name and returns the total number of objects in the bucket, handling pagination so that buckets with more than 1,000 objects are counted correctly.
Create a JSON IAM policy document that allows read-only access (s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket) to a single S3 bucket named 'analytics-reports' and denies all delete actions on that bucket.
Write a regular expression that matches valid AWS EC2 instance IDs (for example, i-0abcd1234efgh5678 or i-1234567890abcdef0), which begin with 'i-' followed by either 8 or 17 hexadecimal characters.
